name: widgetKit
description: Pooled, versioned widgets with explicit layouts in a small core, and parts for each group of widget types, a virtualised list over the client's ScrollBox framework, a normalised anchor value type with position persistence, and a renderer for OptionsKit trees, for World of Warcraft addons.
summary: Pooled, versioned widgets with explicit layouts, saveable anchors and an OptionsKit renderer.

Containers.description: The container types Frame (a movable, resizable window), Group and ScrollFrame.

Text.description: The display types Label, Heading and Spacer.

Button.description: The Button type, key capture included.

CheckBox.description: The CheckBox type, two- or three-state.

Slider.description: The Slider type, a slider with a value box.

EditBox.description: The EditBox type, single- and multi-line text entry.

Dropdown.description: The Dropdown type and CreateMediaPicker, a Dropdown over a MediaKit list.

ColorPicker.description: The ColorPicker type, a swatch over the client colour picker.

ScrollList.description: The ScrollList type, a virtualised list over the client's ScrollBox framework.

Position.description: WidgetKit.Anchor, the normalised anchor value type, and BindPosition, a frame's position kept in a storage table.

Renderer.description: RenderOptions: OptionsKit trees rendered into WidgetKit containers, with childGroups pages and extension points for later parts.
